audience: online store owners who sell and manage stock with Sapo

useCases.title: Review orders and what is unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists orders with line items, customer, totals, payment and fulfillment status, filtered by status, tag, customer or dates, and counts matching orders.

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock
useCases.text: The AI lists stock per item and location with on hand, available and committed counts, filtered by a maximum available quantity. It uses locations and inventory items to name the products.

useCases.title: Look up customers and how much they spent
useCases.text: The AI lists customers with contact details, order count and total spent, opens one customer, and counts all customers.

useCases.title: Browse products, variants and discount rules
useCases.text: The AI lists products with variants, prices and SKUs, filtered by name, vendor, type or collection, and lists discount price rules with validity dates and usage counts.

useCases.title: Change an order's note or tags, or set a stock quantity
useCases.text: The AI sets the note or tags of an order, replacing the old value, or sets the exact on-hand stock of an item at a location with a reason. Stock changes are recorded as adjustments.
